meta.name: qa-checklist
meta.description: Pre-ship audit checklist for Ethereum dApps. Ship-blocking checks and should-fix checks covering wallet connection, button flows, contract verification, branding, RPC config, and mobile deep linking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐项检查钱包、按钮与合约,确保 dApp 上线前无遗漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在发布以太坊 dApp 前想系统地过一遍关键检查
copy.tagline_en: Run a pre-ship audit for Ethereum dApps, covering wallet, buttons, and contracts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're releasing an Ethereum dApp and want a systematic pre-launch checklist

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按清单对以太坊 dApp 做上线前审计,区分必须修复与建议修复的问题,覆盖钱包连接、按钮流程、合约验证、品牌、RPC 配置和移动端深链接等检查项。
howto.when: 当用户要求对以太坊 dApp 做上线前检查或审计时触发。

say.text: 帮我按 QA 清单审计这个 dApp 的上线准备。
say.note: Claude 会逐项执行清单检查。

say.text: 检查钱包连接和按钮流程有没有问题。
对照清单看看合约验证和 RPC 配置是否合规。

howto.what_en: Claude applies a pre-ship audit checklist to Ethereum dApps, separating ship-blocking checks from should-fix checks across wallet connection, button flows, contract verification, branding, RPC config, and mobile deep linking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a pre-launch audit or checklist review of an Ethereum dApp.

say_en.text: Run the QA checklist on this dApp before launch.
Check wallet connection and button flows.
Verify contract and RPC config against the checklist.
